changes.before: This was a dispute over Undangs before it became one over a Ruler. The throne now depends on who lawfully held three Undang titles on 19 April.
changes.after: Before anyone can say whether a Ruler was lawfully removed, someone must settle who lawfully held three of the four Undang titles on 19 April.
changes.tag: CORRECTED (Stage 2 OVERCLAIM, Stage 3 MISLEADING): titles framed as the threshold question, not the whole test

changes.before: No side disputes that Undangs may remove a Ruler. Whether they lawfully did on 19 April is a question every side has answered and no court has.
changes.after: The DKU and the AGC call the 19 April move invalid; its backers say it stands. No court has ruled on the merits, and in October the four dropped their own suit.
